faq.question: How do I order?
faq.answer: Add items to the cart, enter your delivery details, and open the pre-filled WhatsApp message. You must send the message to request the order.

faq.question: Are the displayed items available?
faq.answer: This site currently contains example products. Check price, availability, and specifications with the store before buying.

faq.question: Is online payment available?
faq.answer: No online payment is collected on this website. Payment options must be confirmed directly with the store.

faq.question: How much is delivery?
faq.answer: Delivery cost and coverage will be confirmed by the store; the cart total excludes delivery fees.
